items.title: Electron runtime contract exists
items.evidence: src/lib/runtime/desktop/desktop-host-contract.ts — 12 privileges, deployment assumptions, exclusive vs shared features.

items.title: Preload bridge is typed and minimal
Native privileges only flow through approved bridge
File-system bridge is explicit and permissioned
items.evidence: fs-bridge.cjs dialog-gated, allowlist, 50MB cap, sandboxed userData/backups.

items.title: Auto-updater works or is clearly disabled
items.evidence: auto-updater.cjs graceful fallback, manual feed via SITA_UPDATE_URL.

items.title: OS shell features are truthfully scoped
items.evidence: 12 privileges enumerated, exclusive vs shared cleanly separated; Tier 2 (not honest OS).

items.title: Unsupported web-only/native-only mismatches are handled
items.evidence: desktop-fallbacks.ts declares fallback for every desktop-exclusive capability.

items.title: App signing/notarization plan exists
items.evidence: forge.config.cjs declares osxSign, osxNotarize, windowsSign env-driven; requires real certs at release time.
items.remediation: Provision Apple Developer ID + Windows EV/OV certs; populate APPLE_* and CSC_* env vars in release CI.
